items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Harrison Bradley used to play down at Lutcher with Diddy and Billy.

ctx.x: Who did Chris usually have on the trombone?

Well Chris used, Ambrose was one of the trombone players. That's sweet now. Harrison Bradley, he was another trombone player. Where did Harrison live? Which one is that? Harrison Bradley used to play down at Lutcher with Diddy and Billy. Oh yeah I know him. When he died. And he played with Chris, yeah. Oh yeah. They would play at certain times, you know, like they'd quit this one and go play with that one, you know. Who was the best blues trombone player? Well Jim Crow was my ideal. I loved to hear Jim play…
Well who would be your favorite trombone just all around?
